title: DNA binding by ATPase-adjacent domains stimulates SMCHD1 ATPase activity
authors: Alexandra D. Gurzau; Richard W. Birkinshaw; Andrew Leis; Tamara Cameron; Megan Iminitoff; Kelsey Breslin; Iromi Wickramasinghe; Samantha Eccles; Hannah K. Vanyai; Quentin A. Gouil; Peter E. Czabotar; James M. Murphy; Marnie E. Blewitt
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和突变分析揭示SMCHD1的BAH-IGL-1结构域结合DNA并刺激ATPase活性，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作机制研究，但非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验结构为主，AI/物理模拟成分有限。
abstract: SMCHD1 is an epigenetic regulator in which heterozygous variants are reported in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD), as well as Bosma arhinia microphthalmia syndrome (BAMS). While we have previously shown that SMCHD1 is able to interact with nucleic acids via its hinge domain, we have now identified a second DNA-binding site that is located C-terminal to the ATPase domain and formed by two domains: the Bromo-adjacent homology (BAH) and immunoglobulin-like 1 (IGL-1) domains. Here, we report their mode of DNA-interaction and we present the first high-resolution structure of the wild-type human SMCHD1 ATPase using site-directed mutagenesis and structural analysis via cryo-EM. We also reveal that DNA-binding at the BAH-IGL-1 domains stimulates the ATPase activity of full-length SMCHD1 in vitro , and demonstrate in a mouse model that ATP hydrolysis is essential for SMCHD1 function in vivo . Together, these findings establish bidentate DNA binding and DNA-stimulated ATP hydrolysis as central features of SMCHD1 function, providing new mechanistic insight into how SMCHD1 regulates gene silencing. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT
abstract_zh: SMCHD1是一种表观遗传调控因子，其杂合变异见于面肩肱型肌营养不良症（FSHD）以及Bosma无鼻小眼球综合征（BAMS）。我们此前已表明SMCHD1能通过其铰链结构域与核酸相互作用，现又鉴定出第二个DNA结合位点，该位点位于ATPase结构域的C端，由两个结构域组成：Bromo邻近同源（BAH）结构域和免疫球蛋白样1（IGL-1）结构域。在此，我们报告了它们的DNA相互作用模式，并利用定点突变和冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）结构分析，首次呈现了野生型人SMCHD1 ATPase的高分辨率结构。我们还揭示，BAH-IGL-1结构域处的DNA结合在体外刺激全长SMCHD1的ATPase活性，并在小鼠模型中证明ATP水解对SMCHD1在体内的功能至关重要。综合这些发现，确立了双齿DNA结合和DNA刺激的ATP水解作为SMCHD1功能的核心特征，为SMCHD1如何调控基因沉默提供了新的机制见解。图形摘要
